name: Early pottery at Xianrendong Cave
description: Mobile foragers at Xianrendong Cave made fired ceramic vessels before local agriculture. The earliest western-area sherds include slab-built fragments with parallel scraping marks. Cooking is a possible use. The contents and purpose remain uncertain.

impact.note: Among the earliest fired vessels anywhere, a new ability for foragers, with a continuing south Chinese tradition plausibly descending from this community.

date.label: 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP
date.basis: Source dates archaeological contexts in calibrated years before present; 1950 is the BP reference.

events.statement: Earliest pottery-bearing contexts are dated 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP. The earliest West Area sherds include slab-built vessels, some with parallel scrape marks.

evidence.supports: The earliest pottery-bearing contexts are dated 20,000–19,000 calibrated years BP.
Summarises forming observations for early slab-built sherds, and distinguishes later coiling and paddling at the cave.

contributions.group: Mobile foragers associated with Xianrendong Cave

evidence.supports: Authors attribute the early cave pottery to mobile foragers.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest date established for this specific documented case by the sources inspected; it does not establish an invention date or world priority.

caveats: Context dating is not direct dating of manufacture; chronology and claimed priority require continued comparison with newer archaeological work.

research.note: Independent check of the archaeological-context date and forager attribution against the cited 2012 paper; source metadata correctly identifies the original abstract-only reading. Review of other facets remains open.

unresolved.about: specific vessel uses and later traditions
unresolved.note: Exterior scorch and soot cannot identify contents or early fermentation. The cave sequence has a later forming technique and occupancy gaps. Lijiagou, Jiahu and Shangshan are separate later assemblages without a demonstrated carrier from Xianrendong.
